items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Ike Levy, because of my interest in his son, Dick, liked me very well

ctx.x: CBS was founded by Ike and Leon Levy. Do you know the Levy people? And the father. A lot of people think...a lot of people don't know the facts, that there were two other factors, and they started CBS in Philadelphia. And then they ventured into New York into, you know, this thing. And the two other persons, so I'm told by Ike, got cold feet...you know, they figured don't move too fast. They got out. And this left Ike and Leon and then out of that came CBS, Columbia Records, TV, and all of that. Right?

Ike Levy, because of my interest in his son, Dick, liked me very well and called Radio Station WCAU in Philadelphia and told whoever the people were to give Sammy Price the piano job. But I know that I wasn't equipped...because, you know, you had a lot of variety acts, you know, and playing shows, and horse acts, and mule acts, and so I just didn't avail myself, I didn't put myself in the position to go that route.

So as a result of not putting myself in that position, you know, not being really properly equipped, not following through with all the things that Mrs. Pittman was teaching me about reading music and I just felt that that was too taxing on my mind, so I bypassed it. So as a result of that...I probably could have ended up being...because Ike liked me that well...he liked me well enough that I could have just gone on, you know...he wasn't paying any attention to color. 'Cause if I had had the ability which I knew…
